summary: The old harness has two preexisting maintenance gaps: it never enables comment saving, and it leaks the parser when parsing reports an error.

claims.necessity_reason: Comment saving is a supported parser mode within this string parsing target. The old harness always constructs the parser with flags 0, so no fuzz input can enable that mode or exercise the comment handling affected by the selected changes.

before.requirement: String parsing must be able to save input comments in the parser context when UCL_PARSER_SAVE_COMMENTS is enabled.
before.reason: The flag and guarded comment saving already existed, but the harness always passes 0 to ucl_parser_new.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Comment saving is guarded by UCL_PARSER_SAVE_COMMENTS.

after.requirement: String parsing must be able to save input comments in the parser context when UCL_PARSER_SAVE_COMMENTS is enabled.
after.reason: The selected changes manage saved comments, but the old harness still passes flags 0.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The same flag guards comment saving after the change.
Change g0001 updates handling of a saved last_comment.
Change g0002 adds cleanup of a pending saved comment.

claims.comparison_reason: The supported comment saving mode exists on both sides; the same fixed parser flags make it unreachable on both sides.

claims.necessity_reason: A finite input such as an unmatched opening brace produces a parser error after allocation. The harness returns when it sees that error without freeing the parser, leaving its allocated state alive.

before.requirement: Release the parser and its owned state when string parsing reports an error.
before.reason: The parser cleanup operation existed, but the harness returns from the error branch before calling it.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: An unmatched opening brace records an error and returns false.
The harness error check sees the recorded error string.

after.requirement: Release the parser and its owned state when string parsing reports an error.
after.reason: The changed destructor also releases a pending saved comment, but the harness still returns before calling the destructor on an error.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The same unmatched brace error path remains after the change.
The harness error check still sees the recorded error string.

claims.comparison_reason: Both versions require cleanup on the same error path. The old harness skips ucl_parser_free on that path in both versions.

missing_information: The implementation of ucl_object_unref in src/ucl_util.c is needed to finish assessing all effects of the saved-comment cleanup changes.
